hook.line: Something huge just changed in Google, and most business owners have no idea.
hook.visual: Bearded man with a lav mic in hand against a night city skyline; 'Historic Change To Branded SEO' title scrambles into place in the top band.

beats.what: Title 'Historic Change To Branded SEO' animates in with scrambled letters, then locks for the whole video
Data point: AI Overviews on roughly 83% of branded searches
Explains Google may show an AI summary of your company before your site
The important part: Google pulls from YouTube, LinkedIn, Wikipedia and others
Warns that content can be placed or owned by others
Authority line: 23 years in SEO, biggest shift in branded search
Takeaway: watch what AI knows and says about your brand
Asks to follow and comment for daily SEO and AI tips

why_it_works: Persistent top-band title tells a muted scroller the topic in every frame of a single 78 s shot
A specific stat (83% of branded searches) early turns a vague 'something changed' into a credible claim
Stakes are personal: it is about what Google says about your own company, which business owners care about
Night skyline and handheld lav mic look like an expert's casual aside, matching the 23-years authority line
weaknesses: Zero cuts in 78 s and only one motion event; nothing visual changes after the title lands
The 83% stat is only spoken and in captions, never shown as a graphic
First word at 0.69 s with a slow 'So, something huge...' opener wastes the first second
Captions and title both sit outside the safe area (outside_safe_share 1.0)
for_robert: Use one scrambling title that locks into the top band in the first second and stays, but avoid his single static shot: let Fred cut in with the stat as a sign at least every 10 s.
